description: Apply a chmod mode to a starting mode. The grammar is GNU chmod: symbolic [ugoa]*([-+=][rwxXst]* or one of ugo), comma separated, or =644 / +1, or a bare octal. No spaces. If who is omitted, bits set in umask are not changed; the default umask is 0. Explicit who ignores umask. X adds execute only on a directory, or when an execute bit is already set. On a directory, bare octal shorter than five digits keeps set-user-ID and set-group-ID; =755, 00755, or a symbolic s clears them. The sticky bit is not kept across = or bare octal. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/chmod-apply
name: chmod_apply
title: Chmod Apply
